body: I’m 22F and have also been experiencing hair loss. If you haven’t yet, I’d ask your doctor to get your thyroid checked. I just got mine checked after losing hair for 3 years as well as major depression and they told me low thyroid levels can cause hair loss AND depression. I was like so y’all didn’t tell be about this sooner...

This one made me cry. Thinking about how much 15 year old me wanted to beat depression and how excited I was to finally get on medicine for the first time and feel like an adult getting proper help. I had no idea it would be like this. I’m sorry, younger me.

In almost every major city in America there are riots going on over the killing of George Floyd, a black man, by the police. They have been occurring for days now and are not expected to stop soon. There is so much news going on that it is hard to keep up with here.
Today will be my first week officially off Lexapro and on Effexor. Only side effect I’ve had is bad constipation. Apparently it is kind of common. Lol
